contribution.limit: Selected consistency audit; exploratory choice; no new inequality theorem or exhaustive priority claim

evidence.checks: Six original/derived source representations; 12 local hashes; pinned PDF, TeX and growth-paper downloads match; public narrow evidence record

execution.checks: 2620 planned rows,15 tests,10 numerical hashes reproduced; exact fractions and60-digit CES checks

inference.limit: Synthetic arithmetic; no empirical forecast, equilibrium solution, general policy ranking or model of behavior

review.checks: Five source/text issues resolved; reviewer interpreter prose corrected; no central code or numerical output changed

disclosure.checks: AI roles, exploratory design, source dates, implementation choices and absence of human review explicit

release_hygiene.checks: UTF-8 files inspected; no account paths, email addresses, secret patterns or restricted full texts; public target verified; staged whitespace check still recorded in parent release
